notes: SAC+DAgger OOD-circle reproduction matches the archived aggregate essentially exactly.
Single-shape PPO OOD-circle reproduction matches the historical aggregate essentially exactly.

Multi-shape PPO geometric coverage and RMSE are close to the archived aggregate, but sequential coverage is materially higher in the clean reproduction. Because sequential coverage is waypoint-index based and known to be sensitive/gameable, both values are preserved rather than reconciled.

The clean SAC+DAgger training-square reproduction is strong but differs from the archived standalone aggregate; the historical OpenCV version and exact standalone evaluation utility state were not recoverable from the checkpoint.
